title: Cargo Liability, CargoCare and Cargo Claims: which claim file and figures a settlement approval uses
content:
## Scope

This rule of the Cargo Liability, CargoCare and Cargo Claims product line identifies the claim file on which a settlement amount is fixed when a claim is approved, and the figures taken from it.

## Rule

1. The claim approved is the cover's claim file in the documents-complete state. A cover carries at most one such file.
2. The claim amount, the number of affected packages and the affected gross weight in kilograms are taken from that file.
3. Because only one claim is open on a cover at a time, that file is also the most recent notice on the cover, and the kind of loss is the kind named on that most recent notice.

## Input, judgement, output

```
Claim files on the cover
  -> keep the one file in the documents-complete state
  -> read from it: claim amount, affected packages, affected weight (kg)
  -> kind of loss: the kind named on the most recent notice on the cover (the same file)
```

## Points of judgement

**The cover also shows an earlier file that was decided and closed. Which figures are used?** Those of the file in the documents-complete state; a decided earlier file is not that file.

**The claimant gives a different amount on the call. Which amount is used?** The claim amount recorded on the documents-complete file; the figures are taken from that file.

**Two containers were damaged. Can the approval add the second container's packages?** No. The figures are those of the one documents-complete file on the cover.
